description: Start background extraction of sorted supported files directly inside a local folder, skipping directories and subfolders. Returns one task_id per confirmed upload without waiting for processing or exporting. At most 10 uploads run concurrently. Use wait_for_task_extraction for each task, then fetch or download results using its document IDs. Uploads may consume credits. Inspect failed entries and recovery IDs before retrying; cancellation prevents new uploads, but submitted tasks may still run. Entries marked unstarted were not uploaded. auto_approve defaults true; false requests human review, which MCP cannot perform or approve.

auto_approve.description: Automatically approve extracted documents. Defaults to true. Set false only when human review is requested; use a start-only extraction tool to retain the task ID. MCP cannot approve documents, and combined extraction may time out while review is pending.

folder_id.description: Optional remote Suparse folder ID to assign to uploaded documents.

folder_path.description: Path to a local folder on the machine running this MCP server, not a remote Suparse folder ID. Scans supported files directly inside it, nonrecursively. Prefer an absolute path; relative paths use the server's working directory and ~ is not expanded.

pdf_password.description: Optional password for an encrypted PDF. Treat this as a secret; it is used only for the upload and is not returned in results.

split.description: Enable auto-splitting of multi-page documents with mixed document types.

template_id.description: Optional extraction template ID. Use only a non-system team template ID from list_templates. System template IDs are discovery-only and cannot be passed directly. Omit to let Suparse auto-detect, or use an authorized quick-schema workflow to create a team template.

name: start_folder_extraction
title: Start Folder Extraction
